subject.title: fix(xai): respect ssrfPolicy and request.allowPrivateNetwork in image_generate

question: Should xAI image generation adopt the complete sanitized models.providers.xai.request policy, including private-network, headers, auth, proxy, and TLS overrides, through useConfiguredRequest?
rationale: The canonical helper is architecturally preferable, but it intentionally changes more transport behavior than the PR title and proof describe, and that security/compatibility scope requires owner confirmation.

options.title: Adopt canonical request policy
options.body: Keep useConfiguredRequest, update the PR description to cover the full request-policy surface, and require current-head production-path proof before merge.

options.title: Limit the authorization change
options.body: Implement a narrower shared seam that propagates only allowPrivateNetwork if maintainers do not want other xAI request overrides applied to image generation.

options.title: Retain default denial
options.body: Close the PR and continue blocking private xAI image endpoints if the existing provider request setting is not intended to authorize image-generation traffic.

recommendation.title: Adopt canonical request policy
recommendation.body: Keep useConfiguredRequest, update the PR description to cover the full request-policy surface, and require current-head production-path proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision concerns the intended contract of the provider request configuration surface introduced through their merged work.
